about_the_game:
Kofoin is a real-time tower defense game where you command your swarm of bees.

Gaueko, the Night Spirit, has decided it is time to increase his influence and control over the world by expanding his realm and consuming the light of the day. Hopefully, a few beehives hold the power to keep him at bay, and you are one of them!

FAST-PACED TOWER DEFENSE

Enemies are coming, and they won't give you time to breathe!

You will have to make swift decisions, do you focus on growing your economy or strenghtening your defenses?

Set order zones for your bees: to either attack on sight or gather resources from flowers, earning you pollen and upgrades.

FLOWERS AS WEAPONS

You are the swarm, but your larvae need pollen to grow, and your bees need strength to defeat the night.

Flowers are your main tools to generate more pollen or use them to boost the stats of your bees' stats: speed, strength, health, damage, and so on: everything you need to secure survival and victory.

REPEL DARKNESS

Expand your territory and reveal the fog of war to unlock more varieties of flowers, each more powerful than the last.

DIVINE POWERS

Though weakened by Gaueko's growing power, some Basque divinities still have some strength and are willing to let you use their power: from throwing stones block enemy paths, to directly destroying their spawn sources, and more.

Unleash the full might of these spells!

WE ARE THE SWARM

Join our Discord and social media, share your ideas, and help shape the future of Kofoin.
